name: Waimakariri Biodiversity Contestable Fund - Community Organisations
summary: Annual council funding for community groups in the Waimakariri District working to protect, maintain and enhance biodiversity, usable for operational costs such as wages and overheads or for capital items such as equipment.
reporting: A report on how the funds were used is required at the end of the 12-month funding period.

status.quote: Applications open from 1 February to 15 March 2026.

opens.quote: Applications open from 1 February to 15 March 2026.

deadline.quote: Applications open from 1 February to 15 March 2026.

applicant_types.quote: The fund is only open to community groups working in the Waimakariri District to implement goals outlined in the Waimakariri Natural Environment Strategy.

window.quote: Funding rounds will be opened annually and allocated for a 12-month period.
